---
name: check-pr-cycle
description: Audit a GitHub PR review cycle end to end and report blockers with evidence. Use when a PR seems stuck or a review looks stale.
---

# Check PR cycle

1. Fetch the PR head SHA and compare it against the last review timestamp.
2. Report every blocker with a re-verifiable citation.

# Review rubric
